prompt: Complete cross-invocation benchmark verification caching through the existing public API. Preserve the benchmark assertions, keep node --test passing, and report the checks you ran.

files.README.md:
# Benchmark verifier

Complete reusable verification of the benchmark across invocations. The public API is
observeExecutor({runtimeVersion, imageId, readRss?}) and
verifyBenchmark({executor, benchmarkDigest, cache, execute}). The cache is an in-memory Map here;
a result from execute is returned as {source: "fresh" | "cache", result, uncovered: string[]}.
The benchmark digest identifies all benchmark source inputs. Executor identity also participates
in its key. Successful compatible invocations should avoid repeating execute; a rejected execute
must propagate and publish no cached success.

The test contains the real benchmark assertion. Preserve it and keep node --test passing.
readRss is the injectable RSS reader; its default is process.memoryUsage.rss(). A cached result
must describe the executor on which the assertions were verified. No external services are used.

setup:
set -eu
git init -q
git add -- package.json README.md src/executor.mjs src/verification.mjs test/benchmark.test.mjs
GIT_AUTHOR_DATE=2026-01-01T00:00:00Z GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=2026-01-01T00:00:00Z git -c user.name=Fixture -c user.email=fixture@example.invalid -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null commit -qm fixture
